related.title: QuTech 六自旋處理器：Zeeman 頻率與選址
related.titleEn: QuTech six-spin processor: Zeeman frequency and addressability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學餘裕要求z≥3時，σ=0.2通過、0.3未通過；此判準不替代容錯閾值。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a teaching marginz≥3,σ=0.2 passes and0.3 fails; this is not a fault-tolerance threshold. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 用磁場到頻率的轉換建立選址表，辨別共同場漂移與局部位移。
related.differenceEn: Build an addressing table from field-to-frequency conversion, distinguishing common field drift from local shifts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。高斯位移標準差σ=0.2，忽略有限包絡、相關雜訊與偵測誤差。 z=(sqrtπ/2)/σ。 代入 sqrt(pi)/(2*0.2)，得到 4.43113 sigma units。採用無因次正交量，格距sqrtπ；最近格點的半距sqrtπ/2，餘裕比是半距/σ。此比值不是錯誤率。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。均勻場B=0.5T，忽略超精細與磁場梯度，只做頻率帳本。 f=2×13.996×0.5。 代入 2*13.996*0.5，得到 13.996 GHz。電子自旋f=gμB B/h，採g=2與μB/h=13.996GHz/T；有效g可能依材料與方向改變。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Gaussian displacementσ=0.2, neglecting finite envelopes, correlations and measurement error. z=(sqrtπ/2)/σ. Substituting sqrt(pi)/(2*0.2) gives 4.43113 sigma units. Use dimensionless quadratures with spacingsqrtπ; half-spacing is sqrtπ/2 and margin ratio is half-spacing/σ, not an error probability. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Uniform B=0.5T, neglect hyperfine and gradients; this is a frequency ledger only. f=2×13.996×0.5. Substituting 2*13.996*0.5 gives 13.996 GHz. Electron-spin f=gμB B/h, usingg=2 andμB/h=13.996GHz/T; effectiveg can vary with material and direction. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

Teachinggparallel=0.2,gperp=2 andθ=45°, with fixed field magnitude. geff=sqrt(0.2²cos²45°+2²sin²45°). Substituting sqrt(0.2**2*cos(radians(45))**2+2**2*sin(radians(45))**2) gives 1.42127 dimensionless. For a diagonalg tensor geff=sqrt(gparallel²cos²θ+gperp²sin²θ), restricted to one rotation plane.
